summary: Recover, complete, validate, and publicly publish the Agent Quality Gauntlet v2 source distribution.
behavior_changes: The public repository presents one coherent v2 CLI, installer, documentation set, and reproducible release build.
High-assurance and release profiles generate and validate deterministic CycloneDX dependency inventories.
Automatic setup distinguishes existing repositories from greenfield repositories and installs browsers only when explicitly requested.
behavior_preserved: Exit 0 means pass, exit 1 quality failure, exit 2 configuration failure, and exit 3 infrastructure failure.
Missing, stale, malformed, or untrustworthy evidence fails closed.
Existing JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Python adapter behavior remains supported.
Policy, expected-output, waiver, and approval changes remain protected and reviewable.
failure_detection: Unit tests, internal conformance fixtures, package builds, deterministic release rebuild comparison, disposable-project setup smoke tests, and GitHub remote verification.
rollback: Revert the initial public commit or delete the newly created GitHub repository before external adoption; no existing remote or production deployment is modified.
